The user wants to see monthly churn rate for Enterprise vs Professional vs SMB accounts in 2024. I need to map the tiers I discovered earlier to these categories:

- Professional: likely "pro" tier
- SMB: likely "starter" or "growth" tier

WITH account_tiers AS (
    SELECT 
        s.account_id,
        p.tier,
        CASE 
            WHEN p.tier = 'enterprise' THEN 'Enterprise'
            WHEN p.tier = 'pro' THEN 'Professional'
            WHEN p.tier IN ('starter', 'growth') THEN 'SMB'
        END as segment
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
),
monthly_churn AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.churned_at)::date as month,
        at.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) as churned_accounts
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN account_tiers at ON s.account_id = at.account_id
    WHERE s.status = 'churned'
        AND s.churned_at >= '2024-01-01'
        AND s.churned_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY month, at.segment
),
monthly_total AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at)::date as month,
        at.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) as total_accounts
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN account_tiers at ON s.account_id = at.account_id
    WHERE s.started_at >= '2024-01-01'
        AND s.started_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY month, at.segment
)
SELECT 
    mc.month,
    mc.segment,
    mc.churned_accounts,
    mt.total_accounts,
    ROUND(100.0 * mc.churned_accounts / mt.total_accounts, 2) as churn_rate_pct
FROM monthly_churn mc
JOIN monthly_total mt ON mc.month = mt.month AND mc.segment = mt.segment
ORDER BY mc.segment, mc.month
